outcome: Changes in cardiac output in the first 15 minutes after birth
cohort: 100 term neonates delivered by elective caesarean section
finding: Cardiac output in term neonates tends to increase in the first few minutes after birth, before decreasing from minute 4 until 10 minutes after birth.
mod_finding: This study investigated hemodynamic changes in term infants delivered via elective cesarean section using electrical velocimetry.
